details: Bitcoin experienced a significant sell-off, dropping below $67,000 and registering a decrease of around 4.5% to 6.73% in 24 hours. The decline is attributed to Strategy's (likely MicroStrategy) first Bitcoin sale in four years and a broader institutional capital shift towards artificial intelligence following Google's substantial AI raise. Analysts are now eyeing the $63,000 to $60,000 range as potential retest levels.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $67,000 Amid Selling Pressure and AI Shift

details: Standard Chartered analysts suggest that Strategy's recent Bitcoin sale might signal the beginning of Ethereum (ETH) outperforming Bitcoin (BTC). This dynamic is highlighted by Bitcoin's sharper decline compared to Ether, which has fallen less, and the perceived structural advantages of staking-capable treasury models for ETH.
title: Standard Chartered Predicts Ethereum Outperformance Over Bitcoin

details: While Strategy (MicroStrategy) sold 32 BTC, Strive announced the acquisition of 2,500 Bitcoin for $185.2 million at an average cost of $74,092 per coin. This purchase, funded through common stock and preferred stock sales, brings Strive's total Bitcoin holdings to 19,000 BTC, valued at approximately $1.3 billion.
title: Strive Acquires 2,500 BTC Amidst Market Downturn

details: Senators Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren are advocating for the Labor Department to repeal a proposed rule that would allow cryptocurrency investments within 401(k) retirement plans. This move reflects ongoing regulatory scrutiny and concerns regarding the inclusion of volatile assets in retirement accounts.
title: US Senators Push to Block Crypto in 401(k) Plans

details: Coinbase has made an open market purchase of ENA, investing in Ethena, and also announced a new partnership. Additionally, Coinbase is investing in a stablecoin reserve ETF issued by ProShares. These moves highlight Coinbase's strategic engagement with DeFi protocols and stablecoin-related institutional products.
title: Coinbase Invests in Ethena and ProShares Stablecoin ETF

details: Stellar (XLM) experienced a notable 4.93% price swing in 5 hours, driven by the DTCC's tokenization deal and increasing institutional adoption. This development has contributed to XLM's upward momentum, showcasing the impact of real-world asset tokenization initiatives on specific cryptocurrencies.
title: Stellar (XLM) Sees Volatility Amidst DTCC Tokenization Deal

details: Render (RENDER) saw a 10% increase as investors shifted their focus towards AI-linked tokens. This surge is primarily attributed to a broader enthusiasm for artificial intelligence in the market and a technical breakout for the token, rather than specific Render-related news.
title: Render (RENDER) Surges on AI Token Rotation
